latest.title: Imports that read Smart Delivery, and your own order figures
latest.summary: The weekly imports now understand the purchasing agent's Smart Delivery setting: its amount is a stock level the agent tops up to each Monday, not a delivery, and the board judges it that way, in the order the game delivers your contracts. The imports table shows what arrived last week, what is set in game ("in stock" or "a week"), and a Set to box with the board's suggestion that you can change. Your figures carry into the Plan imports checklist, which names the importer to change when a material has more than one contract. For Smart Delivery the suggestion is the stock that runs everything the depot feeds at full capacity for a week, so it only moves when your capacity does.
